title: SIDESTORY: EXODUS FROM THE PALE SEA OPEN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: EXODUS FROM THE PALE SEA OPEN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Exodus From The Pale Sea event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
Phase 1 [Across the Salt Flat]
Phase 2 [Through the Skeletal Reef]
[Sailing Schedule]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Sailing Schedule] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Rose Salt], 'Cuna de Nene' Cabin (Pieces), Module Materials, [Saltfin Garum], etc.
[Salt Ship Marketplace]

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [Saltfin Garum] by clearing event stages and completing [Sailing Schedule] missions. [Saltfin Garum] can be used to redeem items from [Salt Ship Marketplace].
REWARDS: Rose Salt's token, 'Cuna de Nene' Cabin (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, MARTHE Collection - Shoal Beat for Blue Poison, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
-During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Public Affairs].
-After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Intermezzi].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – CONFIRMATION, COMPLETION, CONDUCTION
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Confirmation, Completion, Conduction], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Thorns the Lodestar
★★★★★: Tecno / Grain Buds

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 NEW OPERATORS NOW AVAILABLE
The following Operators will be added to the game:
★★★★★★: Thorns the Lodestar
★★★★★: Tecno / Rose Salt
Note:

- Operator Rose Salt is currently ONLY available from the Exodus from the Pale Sea event, and is NOT available in [Confirmation, Completion, Conduction] headhunting or any [Standard Headhunting] and [Kernel Headhunting].
- Thorns the Lodestar and Tecno will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after June 19, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Thorns the Lodestar, Tecno, and Rose Salt will gain more trust in the event stages during the event.
04 BASE FUNCTION UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: June 5, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: After the version update on June 5, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7), the Base will add the Activity Room. The Activity Room supports Furniture Decoration and can enable Action Mode to guide Operators' actions. Additionally, some Base functions will be optimized:
- In the Factory, Dualchip production time is adjusted to 1 second.
- The Overview function adds Dormitory Edit Lock. Locked slots and the Operators within them will not be affected by [Rotate] or [Rest Ops].
- The Reception Room's area is expanded and can be decorated with Reception Room Furniture.
- Added remaining work time display for some rooms. A Rest Rotation Notification switch is added in Settings.
- Visual upgrades for facilities including the Workshop, Office, Training Room, Elevator, and others.
05 NEW MAIL FOLDER FEATURE
UPDATE TIME: June 5, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: After the version update on June 5, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7), the Mail Folder feature will be added. After being claimed, stamped mails will be automatically saved in the Mail Folder. The mail content and special attached gifts can be reviewed in the Mail Folder at any time. (Stamped mail from previous periods will be retroactively added in batches based on actual circumstances.)
06 NEW MODULE SHOWROOM
UPDATE TIME: June 5, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: After the version update on June 5, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7), the Module Showroom will be added. Players can quickly view and manage module information through the [Module Archive] and [Module Overview] in the Module Showroom.
0 7 STATIONARY SECURITY SERVICE UPDATE
Update Time: June 5, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)

Details: After maintenance on June 5, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7), players will be able to unlock the Total Proxy Command Authority function for security operations. To unlock it, players must complete at least one stage without using support units during a service season. Each Total Proxy Auto Deploy costs 2 [Regular Tasks Proxy Cards] , and rewards will be granted based on the highest stage reached in the current service season.

◆ [Regular Tasks Proxy Cards] can be obtained by completing Daily Missions, and your [PRTS Proxy Annihilation Cards] will be upgraded to [Regular Tasks Proxy Cards] after maintenance on June 5, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7).

◆ After maintenance on June 5, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7), all the players who logged in and created a character before June 5, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) will receive a mail containing [Regular Tasks Proxy Cards] *6. The mail will expire in 30 days.
0 8 UI CONFIG PLANS UPDATE
Update Time: June 5, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)

Details: After maintenance on June 5, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7), players will be able to customize and save multiple plans for their home screen, including selecting Operator outfits for auto-rotation, and setting different themed UI and backgrounds for each individual plan.
09 SHINING STEPS COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Shining Steps Collection - Dreaming High for Ray
Shining Steps Collection - Top Tier Live for Tequila
10 ICEFIELD MESSENGER COLLECTION & EPOQUE COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Icefield Messenger Collection - Maiden for the Bright Night for Goldenglow
Icefield Messenger Collection - Untold Stories for Erato
Icefield Messenger Collection - Aftershow for Greyy the Lightningbearer
Icefield Messenger Collection - Occasionally Flushed for Penance
Icefield Messenger Collection - Dance for Tsukinogi
Icefield Messenger Collection - Gratitude Gift for Qanipalaat
EPOQUE Collection - Ingenious Servant for Kjera
EPOQUE Collection - Amidst the Pieces for Puzzle
11 NEW FURNITURE SET – 'CUNA DE NENE' CABIN
DETAILS: Brand new set of themed furniture, 'Cuna de Nene' Cabin will be available.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
Exodus from the Pale Sea event rewards and redeemable (Pieces)
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
12 LIMITED-TIME PACKS AVAILABLE
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available at the Store for a limited time.
[ SPECIALIST CHIP PACK]
CONTENTS: Specialist Dualchip * 4, Specialist Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
[Salt Flat Supply Funding Box]
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 13, LMD *300000
[Mar Pálido Battle Records Pack]
CONTENTS: Strategic Battle Record * 200, Tactical Battle Record * 300, Frontline Battle Record * 400
13 NEW REDEEMABLE S AVAILABLE IN [DISTINCTIONS] AND [UNIVERSAL CERTIFICATES EXCHANGE AREA]
UPDATE TIME: June 5, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: New redeemables in [Distinctions] and [Universal Certificates Exchange Area]:
Operator Erato and her Tokens
Test Collection Series - Species Plantarum for Perfumer
OTHERS:
The Black Forest Wills A Dream available in [Side Story]
Starts at: June 12, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
Please stay tuned for more information!
